kpis.definition: Revenue won with a close date in the fiscal quarter, against the committed forecast stored at its start: deals already won plus open deals in the Commit forecast category closing in the quarter. 100% means the team won exactly what it committed; it can exceed 100%.
kpis.formula: actual revenue ÷ committed forecast × 100, per quarter
kpis.label: Forecast accuracy
kpis.note: No forecast was stored at the start of Q1 FY 2025-26. It is stored automatically in the first days of every quarter (admins can store it by hand on the Forecast tab).

kpis.definition: Live contacts that belong to an unresolved duplicate group (same email apart from case, dots or +tags in personal addresses; same or similar name at the same company; or the same phone number), out of all live contacts in scope. Merging the group resolves it.
kpis.label: Duplicate contact rate
kpis.note: Workspace-level KPI: shown to admins and the Sales Head.

kpis.definition: Users who signed in or used the app during the week (Monday to Sunday, UTC), out of the workspace's active users (licensed seats).
